doctrine: Holiday is a separate lane that uses theme-matching mechanics. Holiday is a theme-matching lane, not a permanent track classification.
rules: No track, PIX, KK, CI, or II is tied to any holiday because of prior use.
Holiday candidates are collected by theme, feeling, metadata, MetaGrab tags, and admin filters.
Holiday use does not rename a PIX title.
Holiday use does not change source ownership, source title, or permanent metadata.
Mother's Day, Father's Day, Valentine's Day, Thanksgiving, Easter, and similar events are presentation contexts only unless title/admin-marked.
Christmas is not automatic either; it requires title support or admin marking.
Past holiday events are artifacts and must not drive future matching logic.
